info.name: LabelGuard API
info.description:
Seeds data and tests every endpoint in docs/api-contract.md. Run the folders in order: later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

File uploads use paths relative to the repo root: set the Postman working directory (Settings → General → Working directory) to the repo, or pass `--working-dir .` to the Postman CLI.

Each run adds 4 specs and 9 inspections to the database it points at. Don't run it against production in a loop.
